title: Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

question.en: Why did the writer become very worried?
question.zh: 作者为什么变得非常着急？

sentences.en: Why did the writer become very worried?
sentences.zh: 作者为什么变得非常着急？

sentences.en: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
sentences.zh: 牙科医生总是在你无法回答的时候问你问题。

chunks.x: when it is impossible for you to answer

sentences.en: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
sentences.zh: 我的牙科医生刚给我拔掉一颗牙，让我休息一会儿。

sentences.en: but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
sentences.zh: 他知道我收集火柴盒，问我收藏品是否增加了。

chunks.x: I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing

sentences.en: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
sentences.zh: 接着他问我弟弟怎么样，问我是否喜欢在伦敦的新工作。

sentences.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
sentences.zh: 作为回答，我不是点头就是发出奇怪的声音。

chunks.x: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises
to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises
I either nodded or made strange noises

sentences.en: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我的舌头正忙着寻找拔掉那颗牙后留下的窟窿。

sentences.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
sentences.zh: 我突然非常着急，但却说不出话来。

sentences.en: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth,
sentences.zh: 当牙医最后取出我嘴里的药棉时，

sentences.en: I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
sentences.zh: 我才能告诉他，他拔错了牙。

chunks.x: that he had pulled out the wrong tooth
